decisions.statement: The id is said as a word rather than at its flag.
A call saying no id is refused, asking for the id by its placeholder.
A `--` makes the word after it the id rather than a flag this takes none of.
One rule is copied, so words past the id are all named in one refusal.
An id no per-item rule carries refuses the call.

definition: the command copying a per-item rule named by its id
